newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks end weaker but off lows.
newsitem.headline: French stocks end weaker but off lows.

text.p: French stocks finished slightly lower on Thursday as the bourse paused for breath after the previous day's strong gains.
Bonds were flat, and disappointment with half-year results at some companies weighed on the bourse's CAC-40 index, which closed down 5.75 points, or 0.27 percent, at 2,136.09.
The CAC-40 futures contract fell 13 points to 2,136.
* Electric equipment group Schneider fell 3.13 percent to 238.30 francs after reporting a first-half profit of 503 million francs, on the low end of market expectations.
* Eurotunnel shares were still suspended but should requote by next Tuesday, said a source close to the Channel Tunnel operator's debt negotiations with its banks.

* Generale des Eaux rose 0.53 percent to 568 francs. Several brokers upgraded or retained positive recommendations on the share after an analysts' meeting on Wednesday in which the company detailed its telecoms ambitions.
* Shares in AGF up 4.40 francs at 152.40, helped by company road show that has led many analysts to re-evaluate the recently privatised insurance group more positively.
* Carrefour fell 1.23 percent to 2,894 francs on disappointment with the retailer's 0.2 percent September sales rise.
* PSA Peugeot Citroen added 1.20 percent to 589 francs on chairman's remarks at the Paris car show suggesting a more optimistic second-half outlook, traders said.

* Bongrain fell 181 frans to 2,164 after reporting a drop in half-year profit to 129.5 million francs from 164.6 million. Several brokers cut their earnings estimates for the foods group and market sources said brokerage Cheuvreux de Virieu rated the share a sell.
